import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem finite_pointwise_tolerance_locus_closed
  {α : Type} [MetricSpace α]
  (n : ℕ) (f g : Fin n → α → ℝ) (ε : ℝ)
  (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hg : ∀ i, Continuous (g i))
  (z : Set α) (hz : z = {x | ∀ i, |f i x - g i x| ≤ ε}) : IsClosed z := by
  rw [hz]
  have hclosed : ∀ i : Fin n, IsClosed {x : α | |f i x - g i x| ≤ ε} := by
    intro i
    have hcont : Continuous (fun x : α => |f i x - g i x|) :=
      ((hf i).sub (hg i)).abs
    exact isClosed_le hcont continuous_const
  have hcone : IsClosed (⋂ i : Fin n, {x : α | |f i x - g i x| ≤ ε}) :=
    isClosed_iInter hclosed
  have hset :
      {x : α | ∀ i, |f i x - g i x| ≤ ε} =
        ⋂ i : Fin n, {x : α | |f i x - g i x| ≤ ε} := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hset]
  exact hcone
